transcript: Speaker A: UPSC ka score aaya. Maths mein top kiya, reasoning mein top kiya, English comprehension mein fail ho gaya. Overall reject. Ek section ne poora sapna tod diya. [The UPSC score arrived. Topped in Maths, topped in Reasoning, but failed in English comprehension. Overall rejected. One section shattered the entire dream.] Government exam mein English compulsory hai. SSC, UPSC sab mein English ka section hai. [English is compulsory in government exams. SSC, UPSC, all have an English section.] Main do saal se prepare kar raha tha. Har baar English section mein marks kam aate the. Paanch-saat marks ki wajah se cutoff miss hota tha. Coaching laga nahi sakta tha, paise nahi the. [I was preparing for two years. Every time, my marks in the English section were low. I missed the cutoff by five to seven marks. I couldn't afford coaching, I had no money.] Phir English Seekho app mila. Expert ke chhote video hain, Hindi mein samjha ke English sikhate hain. Grammar, vocabulary, comprehension sab cover hai. AI coach se practice ki roz 15 minute. Galat bola, sudhaar di. [Then I found the English Seekho app. There are short videos by experts, teaching English by explaining in Hindi. Grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, everything is covered. I practiced with the AI coach for 15 minutes daily. If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me.] Is baar English section mein cutoff clear. Selection list mein naam hai. Trial sirf ek rupee ka hai. English Seekho app download karo. Wo paanch-saat marks bachao jo har baar sapna tod dete hain. [This time, I cleared the cutoff in the English section. My name is on the selection list. The trial is only for one rupee. Download the English Seekho app. Save those five to seven marks that shatter your dream every time.] Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
